comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A UWC/real life currency only pet, first made available during the New Year's Fortune From Ebisu Treasure Cove (9th-23rd of January 2019).

Stats:

Quarters Rank: 3
Accepted Food: Meat Chunks
Favorite Food: Mixed Pet Food (Meat)
Skills: Pet Plundering: Land & Sea (R1 [Pet Training] Pet Training + Intimacy 20) | Area Search: Land & Sea (R2 Pet Training + Intimacy 40) | Pet Plunder: Scare (R5 Pet Training + 100 Intimacy)

This is probably one of the more powerful and useful pets in-game as it can search for and plunder items on both land and sea, at absurdly low Pet Training skill ranks and intimacy scores. As a trade-off, Scare is a useless ability to those with Marching skill (reduces and eventually eliminates land battle ambushes), and it requires Rank 3 Quarters to equip.

Pretty obviously, there is no other way to acquire this pet beyond playing the Treasure Cove game or buying it from your fellow players who do that; decide for yourself if this cutesy-wootsy-widdle-pupper-doggy is the right companion for you on your own voyage. Cheers.

Source:
